assessments.name: Learning plan
assessments.description: Written learning plan for your placement addressing each of the Australian Association of Social Workers practice standards and comments from Field Educator
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: Mid-placement evaluation and report
assessments.description: This assessment is focused on learning in the first half of placement. It encompasses a 'Mid placement visit interview' including a student presentation and Q&A.
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: End of placement report
assessments.description: The End-of-placement Report is written as a final reflection on your learning throughout the full placement.
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: Learning Circle Group Presentation
assessments.description: Groups present on a placement topic common to their experiences.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement
